announcements.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-dev — Dashboard copy cleanup
announcements.summary: Simplifies Dashboard and settings copy while keeping state, actions, risks, and token details available.
announcements.content:
This development build reduces visual repetition across the Dashboard, settings, account details, About panel, and advanced appearance.
1. Layout: remove secondary labels and descriptions that duplicate section structure, controls, colors, or values.
2. Account cards: keep token input, cached-input, and output details in the existing tooltip instead of the visual card face.
3. Compatibility: preserve the existing extension identity, private-state boundaries, account formats, and local integrations.

zh.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-dev — Dashboard 文案精简
zh.summary: 精简 Dashboard 和设置页文案，同时保留状态、动作、风险与 Token 明细。
zh.content:
本开发构建减少 Dashboard、设置、账号详情、About 和高级外观中的重复说明。
1. 布局：移除可由区块结构、控件、颜色或数值表达的次要标签和描述。
2. 账号卡片：Token 输入、缓存输入和输出明细移入现有 tooltip，保留信息但不占用卡片视觉空间。
3. 兼容性：保留既有扩展 ID、私有状态边界、账号格式和本地集成功能。
